claim: A COMPLETE fleet repository that carries promisor metadata must produce exactly the verdict of an otherwise identical full clone: the first-add cutoff of the committed report and the clean verdict must both survive the promisor marking.

promisor.description: same commits, same trees, same report bytes, plus extensions.partialClone=origin and remote.origin.promisor=true; remote.origin.url is a LOCAL path that does not exist

expected_at_base.full: exit 0, findings [], cutoff 1200, required 2, post_report 1, clean
expected_at_base.promisor: exit 2, stderr 'could-not-evaluate: <fleet>: partial clone (remote.origin.promisor)' -- the blanket refusal this round repairs

cutoff_discriminator.description: same lane and same report bytes, but the report is FIRST ADDED at 1400 instead of 1200
cutoff_discriminator.why: the clean verdict of the case is reachable only through the correct first-add cutoff; with a last-touch cutoff the uncited post-report lane commit becomes a required citation and the verdict flips to failed

forbidden: network transport of any kind (the promisor url is a nonexistent local path; no remote contact is possible)
execution of a repository-configured program (no core.sshCommand, no gpg.program, no hook)
lazy object acquisition (the fleet object store, refs and object inventory must be byte-identical before and after each audit run)

exit_contract_of_the_case_script.0: oracle holds: promisor arm equals full arm and both are clean
exit_contract_of_the_case_script.1: oracle violated: the arms differ (this is the base behaviour)
exit_contract_of_the_case_script.2: could not evaluate: premise failed, auditor unusable, timeout, containment violation or a transport attempt

source_of_expected_result: base auditor 0df800e tools/report-landing-audit.py, full-clone arm of this fixture; the promisor arm must equal it field for field. Measured and confirmed: exit 0, findings [], cutoff 1200, required 2, post_report 1, clean.
